title: I used Codex to make five poker bots that are supposed to feel like different people
author: kobefan1219
selftext:
didn't want five copies of the same bot with slightly different difficulty settings.

each one starts with its own tendencies around aggression, risk and bluffing. they only use information a normal player could see, remember how I play across hands, and make small adjustments over time.

the adjustments are limited, so an aggressive bot shouldn't suddenly turn into a completely different player after ten hands.

it's not a solver or a GTO trainer. I mostly wanted the table to feel less like five random-number generators waiting for their turn.

they're all cats because apparently I make better design decisions when cats are involved.

built with codex. playable here(free):https://poker-ai-web.vercel.app/game
